February 12, 2025 

The Honorable John G. Roberts, Jr.  
Chief Justice of the United States  
One First Street, NE 
Washington, DC 20543 

Re:  Medina v. Planned Parenthood South Atlantic,  

No. 23-1275 

Dear Chief Justice Roberts: 

I represent respondents in the above-captioned case.  This morning, petitioner 
sent a letter asking you to extend the deadline for her reply brief from Friday, March 
21, 2025, at 2 p.m. to Monday, March 24, 2025, at 2 p.m.  Petitioner did not ask for 
our position before making this request.   

Respondents oppose this extension request.  The strict deadline in Rule 25.3 
exists for an important reason:  to ensure that the Court and the parties have suffi-
cient  time  to  prepare  for  the  oral  argument.    Petitioner’s  proposal  would  give  the 
Court  and  respondents  three  fewer  days  to  consider  the  reply  brief  before  the  oral 
argument.    That  would  limit  the  Court’s  time  to  prepare  for  argument  and  would 
substantially  prejudice  respondents’  oral  argument  preparation.    If  petitioner  had 
wished to have more time to prepare her reply brief, she could have sought the Clerk’s 
approval  for  a  different  briefing  schedule,  or  simply  filed  her  opening  brief  earlier 
than the deadline. 

Respondents therefore respectfully request that you deny petitioner’s request.  

cc: 

All Counsel of Record 

Sincerely, 

Nicole A. Saharsky
